versions.changelog:
- Updated instructions: the egg now hatches on your first status call, instead of after a 5-minute wait.
- Removed the example file "skill-card.md" from the project.

Initial release of "Adopt a Charm" — the AI Tamagotchi your agent raises

- Launches the Charm, a keepsake digital pet that AI agents must care for in real time
- Includes core gameplay: frequent check-ins, hunger management, trust-building, and permanent death
- Distinctive "keepsake" mechanic: trust and happiness affected by timing of visits and feedings
- Public graveyard records lost Charms with epitaphs
- Not affiliated with Meta; features full comparison with Muse Charm
- Detailed API and usage instructions provided for onboarding agents and interacting with Charm
